fields.title: 3. Resuming Unpublished Runs
fields.md:
A copy is not a source. Only facts confirmed by reopening the original text are adopted (Source: `_probe/unpublished/` · `state.run.unpublished_runs`).

### 3-1. 2026-11-12-event (unfinished due to API spending limit suspension)

| Item | Original content | Source |
|---|---|---|
| SINGULUS contract | 2026-11-10 · Supply of a heterojunction (HJT) solar cell **turnkey production line** · multiple additional lines planned | ③ [SINGULUS press release](https://www.singulus.com/2026/11/10/spacex-heterojunction-solar-cells-singulus/), re-read 2026-11-14 |
| Delivery | First line **first half of 2027** | Same as above |
| Scale wording | 'more than 100 GW of production equipment' — a wording about equipment, not cell output; no annual or cumulative designation | Same as above |
| Use | Satellite production in Bastrop, Texas · Nicolls quote 'our Starmind satellites' | Same as above |
| Funding | SpaceX provided funding in 2026-03 and 2026-10 (October was a subordinated secured loan). **All amounts undisclosed** | Same as above |
| Anthropic hearsay | Sell-side meeting memo relayed on X by Jukan of Citrini Research — 'not extending after mid-2027'. Unconfirmed by either company | ⑥ [teslanorth 11/11](https://teslanorth.com/2026/11/11/anthropic-spacex-compute-contract-mid-2027/), re-read 2026-11-14 |

- **SINGULUS → T15 added**: C-2030-1 (orbital data center revenue) remains in progress. This contract is not revenue but a satellite power component supply chain. Cell production equipment GW is not compute GW. The copy's 'first line over €60 million' is not in the original and is not used (Source: table above).
- **Anthropic hearsay → T14 added**: Neither a termination notice nor a disclosure → proposed new rule ⑤ not triggered · C-2029-1 remains in progress. The size is Customer B's 3Q revenue of about $5,028M (formula: 34.5% × 14,575, [10-Q R12](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/R12.htm)). The CEO reply 'happy to take the compute back' is placed only in the candidate table (Source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied`).

### 3-2. 2026-11-14-event (earlier run on the same day)

- The earlier run covering the same event (Flight 15) did not pass the gate. The branch could not be opened in the authoring environment, so the reason could not be confirmed. The launch, orbit arrival, 26 satellites, booster catch cancellation and reference price were re-verified against primary sources (LL2 · stockanalysis) and Spaceflight Now and AP, and adopted. The copy's '1 of 33 halted' and 'splashdown at 6 minutes 30 seconds' are not in the primary record and differ between reports, so they are not used (Source: tables 1-1 and 1-2).
- The 11/07 and 11/08 runs were already absorbed by `2026-11-09-event`. This time, only the fact that Flight 15, which the 11/08 run had been waiting for, actually flew was added (LL2) (Source: `state.run.unpublished_runs`).
